verdict.rationale: Braintrust's docs say its Loop agent can build dashboards, and the product page claims real-time tracking of latency, cost, and quality. Traces capture latency and token usage, and scorers produce numeric eval scores, so the underlying metrics exist. However, the custom-dashboard capability itself appears only as a one-line mention, with no documentation of how dashboards are built or configured. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on building custom dashboards or charts, error-rate metrics, explicit eval-score charting, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
